claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spellcasting (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: This feature is a passive class infrastructure grant, not a discrete activation or a simple passive atom bundle. It permanently establishes spell slots, cantrip access, prepared-spell rules, spellcasting ability, and focus usage. The existing class-feature families do not model that chassis honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have learned to cast spells through studying the mystical forces of nature. [...] Spell Slots. The Druid Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. [...] Spellcasting Ability. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Druid spells.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spell_slot_table resource
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Druid spell slots are a multi-level resource keyed by slot level and scaled by druid level, with long-rest recovery. The current activation resources only model one-dimensional use-count or charge pools.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Druid Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cantrip_pool from class spell list
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a known-cantrip pool chosen from the Druid spell list, with replacement on level-up and threshold-based increases at specific class levels. No existing class-feature surface shape models that.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Druid spell list. [...] Whenever you gain a Druid level, you can replace one of your cantrips with another cantrip of your choice [...] When you reach Druid levels 4 and 10, you learn another cantrip of your choice.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: prepared_spell_list from class spell list
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Prepared spells are distinct from known cantrips and from spell slots. The feature grants a class-level-scaled prepared list with eligibility constrained by available slot levels, plus full replacement on Long Rest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. [...] The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. [...] Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spellcasting_ability_and_focus_designation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature designates Wisdom as the spellcasting ability for druid spells and authorizes Druidic Focus use. Those are durable mechanical facts of the spellcasting chassis, but the current surface has no place to record them.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Spellcasting Ability. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Druid spells. Spellcasting Focus. You can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells.
